notes: Fresh retry2 native/all four enlarged whole specimens/new actual and enlarged lower legs inspected. Correct THX gap between upper double trident and detached dash restored. Right outer/inner winding compound and both free top forks fit THX. But lower left three descending courses now all join lower header; THX center staff joins header while both outer side marks are detached. QJZ all-joined lower group also joins upper-left fork unlike current; CCZ only right side joins. Current whole still mixes contacts. Actual lower header has left round terminal spur and right shoulder tracking knots.
requested_corrections: Detach both lower-left outer side marks from lower header, preserving central staff-to-header contact and exact lower terminals, matching whole THX.
Smooth bounded lower header shoulders/junction remnants with no unintended terminal spurs.

Vector correction does not change a mismatching native PNG verdict.

previous_geometry_reviews.notes: Full native, all four complete/enlarged whole references and full/enlarged actual Regular inspected. Native and actual attach the left middle double-U central staff directly to the short dash below. Complete THX has a clear gap above this detached dash, while its upper top fork stays free from the double-U. Other complete variants with joined upper fork or coupled right body do not support the current whole mix. Restore only the gap between lower U/staff and the separate dash, preserving both top fork gaps, two middle U levels, detached bottom three-leg header and independent right winding return with inner elbow, inward rail and long tail.
